source: The PARASOL home page and the DSMLP documentation (2026-09-29 build)
imageNote: Slide art is decorative and carries empty alt text. Regenerate it with `node scripts/render-heroes.mjs`; the motifs drawn as slides are listed in SLIDES there.

slides.title: PARASOL
slides.accent: GPU computing for UC San Diego
slides.description: Jupyter, RStudio, and GPUs for coursework, student projects, and research. Open it in your browser through Datahub or from a terminal.

slides.title: GPUs on reservation
slides.description: Book a GPU window ahead of time, or launch on demand and the system creates a lease for you. Both draw on your workspace's Service Unit budget.

slides.title: Formerly DSMLP
slides.description: Your sign-in, your files, and the Datahub address are the same as before. Every DSMLP documentation page now lives here.
